request.sourceBinding: All candidates bind the same exact primary source SHA-256 and byte size.
request.candidatePlanDigest: SHA-256 stable fingerprint of canonical timeline plus candidate exportSpec.
request.rendererConfigDigest: SHA-256 stable fingerprint of R16 concurrency/resource profile.
request.producerBinding: Exact foto6/video2 Git SHA is part of every candidate cache identity.

runtime.restart: Persisted running candidates recover to pending; terminal siblings remain intact.
runtime.duplicate: Exact duplicate completed batches replay from validated local evidence without rerender.
runtime.failureIsolation: A failed candidate remains failed while successful sibling final/export evidence remains valid.

cache.reuseRule: Cache reuse requires all identity fields plus exact final.mp4 and media.render_export.v1 byte validation.
cache.staleRule: Missing or mismatched artifact/sidecar invalidates the cache entry and forces normal render/QA.
cache.changedSourceOrConfig: Changed source bytes, plan, renderer config or producer SHA cannot reuse the prior entry.

quality.perCandidate: Every cache miss uses preserved media.job.v1 render, R14 objective QA and R15 media.render_export.v1 success/failure semantics.
quality.cacheHit: A hit revalidates exact final bytes and R15 sidecar; it does not synthesize QA.
